title: How to Find a Million Dollar App Idea Fast
description:
Learn how to find a million dollar app idea in under 60 seconds. This video shows you a simple playbook.

Go to the app store, find the most popular app in a category. Take a screenshot of the app, its description, and the reviews. Paste these into Claude and ask it to reverse engineer the app. Find the ideal client, their biggest pain point, and the gap in the market. Claude will break down your competition and tell you exactly what offer to bring to market.

App building workshop this Saturday. Comment CLAUDE to get tickets.

#AI #AppIdeas #Tech
